title: Cap. IV Arg. 7 Sol: do not bind whole praedestinatio to the execution τρόπος — Major not universal
pass_a_gloss: Since therefore in both praeordinations the Divine mercy and justice shine forth; that is, both in that by which God decreed to make certain singular persons believers, and in that other by which he promises and performs eternal life to the same believers; both in that by which he decreed not to have mercy on certain persons so far as to soften the same and inspire faith in them; and in that by which he damns the same hardened and unbelieving: the adversaries ought not to have bound the whole and entire reason of predestination to the latter manner; which most properly turns upon the former. These things having been tasted beforehand, I say that the Major of the proposed syllogism is not universal. For every manner in which mercy toward some, justice of God toward others appears, is not that only predestination whose inscrutable depth the Scriptures so greatly celebrate; although in predestination itself properly taken, by which some are destined to life by means of special grace, others are left in death by means of their own demerit, mercy and justice most illustriously play their parts.
pass_b_english: So in both praeordinations mercy and justice shine — in the decree to make certain persons believers, and in the decree that promises and gives those believers eternal life; in the decree not to have mercy so far as to soften some and inspire faith, and in the decree that damns the same hardened unbelievers. Adversaries should not bind the whole reason of predestination to the latter τρόπος; it turns most properly on the former. With that premised: the Major is not universal. Not every τρόπος in which mercy toward some and justice toward others appears is that unique predestination whose depth Scripture so celebrates — though in predestination properly taken, by which some are destined to life by special grace and others left in death by their own demerit, mercy and justice play their parts most clearly.
source_text: Cum igitur in utraque praeordinatione elucescat misericordia ac justitia Divina; hoc est, tam in ea qua Deus decrevit singulares quasdam personas facere credentes, quam in ea altera qua eisdem credentibus vitam aeternam promittit et praestat; tam in ea qua decrevit quarundam personarum non misereri eousque ut easdem emolliat, fidemque illis inspiret; quam in ea qua eosdem obduratos et incredulos damnat: non debuerunt adversarii ad posteriorem τρόπον alligare totam et integram praedestinationis rationem; quae propriissime versatur in priori. Hisce praelibatis, dico Majorem syllogismi propositi non esse universalem. Nam omnis τρόπος in quo apparet erga alios misericordia, erga alios justitia Dei, non est illa unica praedestinatio cujus inscrutabilem profunditatem Scripturae tantopere celebrant; quamvis in ipsa praedestinatione proprie sumpta, qua alii ad vitam mediante gratia speciali destinantur, alii in morte mediante proprio demerito relinquuntur, misericordia ac justitia illustrissime agant partes suas.
